recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source edit is needed for FHIR-22749 unless a future issue reopens broader Location near search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-22749 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration request to remove "Requires the near-distance parameter to be provided also" from the Location near search parameter description because near-distance no longer exists separately as of R4.
initial_application: Commit eef7df40667d772031a1f7bd313612d0d91e4398 applied FHIR-22749 by removing the stale near-distance sentence from source/location/bundle-Location-search-params.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-14216/GF#14216 is the earlier same-change-family decision that merged near-distance into the Location near special parameter. A 2018 implementers Zulip thread records the editor saying near-distance would disappear because it was merged into the single parameter. Later Location near description changes for FHIR-27157 and FHIR-33976 clarified units, errors, sorting, and algorithm notes without reintroducing the stale near-distance requirement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. source/fhir.ini lists location=Location, and source/location/bundle-Location-search-params.xml currently defines Location-near as a special SearchParameter whose description uses [latitude]|[longitude]|[distance]|[units] and does not mention the obsolete near-distance requirement.
